about_the_game:
Coming Soon to Steam

Rise from the pan as the Whole Wheat Hero and embark on a daring adventure filled with treachery, romance, and culinary magic. By choosing the right friends and making hard decisions, you will discover the dark secrets of Hester's megacorp and prove that with the right ingredients, anything is possible.

Story

Set in an idyllic farming hub turned industrial wasteland, the story of Breadventure centers on a fresh-baked loaf thrust into responsibility. Take your party from a scattered assortment of groceries and turn them into a balanced meal as you face challenges that can only be overcome through ingenuity, teamwork, and a magical blend of herbs and spices.

Gameplay

Stretches of exploration and social interaction are punctuated with fast-paced, turn based battles that reward planning ahead and party coordination. Gather ingredients to create magical meals, solve puzzles to find clues and unravel mysteries, curry favor with factions and individuals through a delicate reputation system, and make lasting decisions that shape the world around you.

Features

- Rich storytelling with meaningful character development and emotional depth

- Class-based progression system - choose between four (4) base classes, with branching ability upgrades for each

- Classic turn-based combat enhanced with modern quality-of-life features

- Party synergy - combine class abilities for devastating combos

- Romanceable Companions - choose your words and actions carefully to woo and court your party members

- Vibrant hand-pixeled art style - every square is placed with care

- Original bleep bloops add depth and character to every location

- Meaningful choices that affect your reputation and relationships

- Side quests that deepen character bonds and expand the world's lore

Development Philosophy

Breadventure is baked with love, attention to detail, and deep respect for the classic CRPGs that inspired it. Every character interaction, every sprite,  and every musical note is designed to create an adventure that sticks with you.

Stay Connected

Follow our development journey and be the first to know about updates:

- Wishlist now to be notified at launch

- Follow @FecklessDev on Twitter for regular development updates

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04+ (or equivalent Linux distro)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+ (or equivalent Linux distro)
  • Processor: Intel i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any Dedicated GPU from the past decade
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: A lore rich, party-based RPG about the loaf who became a legend - Choose between Brawler, Thief, Chef and Saint classes, collect delicious (and romance-able) companions, then fight, cook, and schmooze your way to the top of Hester's HQ. Features multiple endings and a diverse assortment of eggs.
